messages:
mira: Hey team — trying to onboard Solace-7B (HF mirror). FP16 vs our INT4 conversion shows a 3-5% drop on PIQA. Suspect KV-cache + embedding-projection ordering mismatch.

kai: Can you paste the minimal repro or logs?

mira: Minimal repro attached in the run: our int4 packer seems to reorder projection dims. Quick snippet:```python
# packing code we used
packed = pack_int4(weights, order='head-major')
# but the model checkpoint is embed-major
```

sophie: Did the tokenizer change? Any special token id shifts (BOS/EOS) between the HF and our loader?

mira: Good catch — tokenizer has BOS=1 in their vocab, ours assumes BOS=0. We remapped tokens during conversion but left the embedding/proj ordering as-is, which I think shifted KV indices by one for long-context reads.

nate: benchbot posted quick metrics: 
benchbot: Automated eval run: sol-7b/int4 -> PIQA FP16=79.2, INT4=75.9, LR 0.0, seed 42

benchbot: Longcontext trace shows divergence at decode step 8 where KV read uses token_id + 1 offset.

kai: If mapping and ordering differ we should permute the proj dims when loading. Try something like:```python
# assume mapping maps old->new token ids
perm = np.argsort(mapping)
weights = weights.reshape(n_heads, head_dim, -1)[:, :, perm]
# then write out packed int4 in the model-expected order
```

mira: Tried permuting + remapping tokens. That recovers ~1.2% of the gap but still ~1.3% behind FP16.

sophie: Another angle: are rotary/rope freqs per-head or global? If converter applied a global frequency but model uses headwise, that can create subtle phase misalignments that look like token drift.

mira: Checked config — Solace uses headwise rotary_factors (per-head scaling). Our converter coerced to single global freq. Updating to headwise frequencies now.

nate: After headwise rotary + proj permute + tokenizer remap: PIQA INT4=78.9 (vs FP16 79.2). Nice — within noise.

mira: Awesome. I'll open onboarding PR with converter fixes, a short migration checklist, and a small CI smoke: roundtrip token ids + kvcache read/write with long context.

kai: Add a regression test that loads both HF and converted weights and asserts logits_close(topk=5) on a few seed prompts. Also add tokenizer id-position sanity check.

benchbot: CI job queued: sol-onboard-int4-smoke #1023 — will run on dedicated infra. :gear: 

sophie: Also update docs: converter flags for --headwise-rotary and --embed-order (head-major|embed-major), and note special token remap step.

mira: Will do. Thanks all. I'll link PR when ready. :thumbsup:
